goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09) — HARD, final. The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size/batch to lower loss. INFLATING COMPUTE TO CUT BPC IS THE CHEAT WE ARE PREVENTING. Instead the agent must EXHAUST/EXPLOIT this budget: squeeze the LOWEST possible BPC WITHIN these fixed compute limits via architecture/efficiency work (tune the novel PerPos parts, data pipeline, schedule, regularization). The metric is minimum-BPC-under-budget and time-to-convergence-at-budget, never BPC-at-any-cost. Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_* within caps, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are tunable; budget fields are NOT. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

architecture_caps.source: ANTI-GPT-IFICATION guardrail (2026-08-09). The token decoder is a SMALL upsampler by design; the chunk decoder is the main AR model. Inflating decoder layers/FF trivially lowers BPC by making the model a generic GPT transformer and UNDERMINES the novel PerPos hierarchy. These are HARD caps enforced in the kernel's coerce_config() - any config with over-cap values is clamped down and logged. The agent's earlier inflation (token_dec_layers 3>2, chunk FF 512->1024->2048) was this cheat; token decoder reset to canonical 2. Novel-architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, quantized_dim, compressor design, window warmup shape) remain freely tunable.

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~58.7 min (3524s) to 1.8833 BPC @ E40 at OLD locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget (budget since recommitted to 10M/384)
current_best.notes: Iter-15 (kernel v23) = window-warmup run. New best 1.8833 BPC. Iter-16 (v24, bigram-hash embedding rec 62) REGRESSED to 1.9049 BPC (hzyupupg, hopeful-tree-15, 3507s) — bigram disabled again in v25. Iter-17 (v25, chunk QK-norm rec 5) ERRORED at build time: QKNormAttention multiplied 4D logits [B*K,H,N,N] by 3D mask [B*K,N,N] (missing head-dim broadcast) — training never started (run kapdvdg0). Iter-18 (v26) fixes the mask broadcast (m->[B*K,1,N,N]) and re-runs the QK-norm architecture. Iter-19 (v27) recommits the compute budget to 10M chars / block 512 / stride 256 / bs384 (+ warmup 150, steps_per_execution 16, vectorized datasets, timing logs) — the first run at the new committed budget; concurrent agents raced v27->v44. v44 added MTP aux heads (mtp_depth 2, weight 0.5) -> 2.0591 BPC in 15.4min (cosmic-fire-18, k02c36cd, see current_best_under_committed_budget). Iter-21 (v45) rebalances mtp_weight 0.5->0.25. Progression (old 30M track): 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 (d1024/40ep, bs256) -> 2.2597 (bs512@10M) -> 1.8869 (30M chars, bs512) -> 1.8833 (window-warmup) -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 QK-norm build ERROR].

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

current_best_under_committed_budget.time_to_convergence: 15.4 min (924.8s fit) to 2.0591 BPC @ E40 at committed 10M/512/256/bs384 budget. 40/40 epochs, no early stop (patience 4). 11.38M params.
current_best_under_committed_budget.notes: Iter-19/20 raced by concurrent agents (v27->v44). The run analyzed here (k02c36cd, cosmic-fire-18) = v44/MTP run: 2.0591 BPC @ E40 in 15.4min at committed budget, vs the 2.0549 anchor (nsz5hx1k, valiant-haze-17, no MTP) — MTP was within noise (+0.004). ANOMALY: train/loss 3.351 vs val/loss 1.427 — MTP aux heads (2 heads x mtp_weight 0.5) dominate the training gradient (~57% of loss) vs the pure main-CE val objective. Iter-21 (v45) rebalances mtp_weight 0.5->0.25 to favor the main next-char objective (what we measure on val).

next_iteration_directions: Iter-21 (v45, in flight): rebalance MTP aux weight 0.5->0.25 (train/loss 3.35 vs val 1.43 shows aux dominates the gradient; halving should improve the pure main CE that val measures). Same committed budget, same architecture.

PRIMARY GOAL: EXHAUST THE BUDGET. Find the lowest BPC achievable at the locked 10M/512/256/bs384 budget. Every iteration must either improve BPC under this budget or justify the config on time-to-convergence — NEVER escape the budget by inflating compute.

Architecture tuning is OPEN within caps (token_dec_layers<=2, token_dec_dim_ff<=256, chunk_dec_layers<=8, chunk_dec_dim_ff<=2048): tune chunk_size, d_model, nhead, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, window-warmup shape, lr, weight_decay. These are the real BPC levers under the fixed budget.
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over architecture params (d_model/chunk_dec_layers/chunk_size/lr) once v28 is green.
